from: live test 1 (script): the planner drew exactly 12 people after the storyboard gate asked for no count

shots.summary: A grid of small neutral dots (residents, illustrative, no count shown). A lottery: a handful of dots light up gold in a seeded random order and move into a circle. Label "Selected by lottery".
shots.action: The teal disc shrinks to a point and leaves a grid of small round-headed resident dots (white at 35%, 18 by 9) on navy. 2.6 s, on "selected by lottery": 12 dots light gold (#F2B705) one by one in a seeded random order (seed 7, 150 ms apart). 4.6 s: the gold dots lift out and glide into a ring at centre (900 ms ease-out) while the rest of the grid fades to 15% (residents inside the ring clear out); a gold ring draws around the group. 5.2 s: label "Selected by lottery" (Text Sans 600, 34px) under the ring. 7.0 s: a thin bright teal outline of a "shared challenge" card appears inside the ring.
shots.transition_in: Teal disc shrinks into the centre of the grid.
shots.transition_out: Horizontal bright teal bar wipe left to right.
reads: 2.6 s: dots light gold, one by one
4.6 s: gold dots gather into a ring
7.0 s: challenge card in the ring

text_overlay.position: source line, bottom left above the caption band (y 780)

shots.notes: No count shown; the grid and the 12 lit dots are illustrative, not a number on screen.

shots.summary: The gold circle of icons in mixed support colours. Two labels build: "Demographics" and "Politics", each with a matching bar pair (no numbers).
shots.action: The ring from S5 returns at left, now as 12 icon discs in mixed support colours (gold, purple, sky, green, teal) with white line people inside, on a gold ring. 2.8 s: label "Demographics" with a matching bar pair: a "Community" bar and an "Assembly" bar of equal length, each split into the same coloured segments, grow from a 3px white baseline (800 ms, 120 ms stagger). 4.6 s: "Politics" with its matching pair, same build. No numbers, no axis.
shots.transition_out: Ring slides off left, the list card rises in its place (continuous, 500 ms).

text_overlay.position: source line, bottom left above the caption band (y 780)

shots.notes: Politics bars use support colours, never the party pair, and show no split; see open question 2.

shots.summary: Hero number "12" in gold with its source line directly under it, label "Community Proposals deliberated", then a light card "Recommendations for the future of housing in Riverton".
shots.action: Navy. 0.8 s: "12" rises in gold (Display Sans 900, 220px, stat-num) left of centre; its source line "Example Town, example.org" fades in directly under it at the same time. 1.4 s: label "Community Proposals deliberated" (Text Sans 600, 42px) beside it. 5.0 s: a white light card slides in at right with navy text "Recommendations for the future of housing in Riverton" and a small round gold badge on its corner (the example's sticker device, no text in it).
reads: 0.8 s: 12 with source line under it

text_overlay.text: Recommendations for the future of housing in Riverton

shots.notes: "12" is the script's "a dozen" (E16: "deliberated a dozen Community Proposals"). No count-up, so no other number ever shows.
